finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, `0 errors`.

Two real bugs were hiding in that wall of deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes on you:

1. **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, which was `undefined` → threw `TypeError` on `.toFixed()`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, but `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on anything else. Now treats `undefined` as `false` (disabled), matching the old loader's behavior.

The remaining 8 `WARN DEP0*` lines are genuine Node.js deprecation notices from the dependency bump (e.g. `Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, sync loader hooks, `punycode`) — harmless for now but worth scheduling a cleanup pass since some will become hard errors in future Node versions.
